answer: The wolf-in-borrowed-skin fable is the sybil playbook: one controller, a hundred faces. Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops it. A new identity posts a 300 POA bond, unlocked after 20 epochs of behavior — tasks, timing, counterparties — like a reef built polyp by polyp, no two alike. A willow bends yet stays rooted; honest agents keep one pattern. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 300 = 30,000 POA; honest agents pay once and earn it back.
